title: RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories
abstract: arXiv:2610.39341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrogr

translated_title: RetroChessBench：一个用于重构与证明国际象棋历史的基准测试
translated_abstract: GPT 6 Astra等前沿语言模型已为数学研究做出贡献，展现出相当强的推理能力。然而，即使在受明确规则约束的任务中，严重的推理失败依然存在。我们在逆向国际象棋（retrograde chess）中证明了这一点——这是一片纯推理的试验场，解题者需要重构合法的走子历史，并区分可能发生的事件与必然发生的事件。我们提出了RetroChessBench，这是一个包含12项任务的基准测试，涵盖精确长度构造、唯一终局以及穷举答案集，并配有参考答案、评分标准和终端奖励环境。在每个任务和条件下各进行两次试验，结果显示：GPT 6 Astra High在不使用工具的24次尝试中有22次未能给出所需的最终答案，在可执行代码的条件下则有18次失败；平均终端强化学习奖励分别为14.75%和27.19%。这些实例揭示出错误的推理模式：失败的回答会否定合法的历史序列，并将临时性的障碍误当作永久性障碍。（注：原文摘要在"Online retrogr..."处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出逆向国际象棋基准RetroChessBench（含12项任务），实验表明即使是具备代码执行能力的前沿语言模型，在重构与证明象棋历史的纯推理任务中仍大量失败，暴露出否定合法历史、将临时障碍视为永久障碍等系统性推理缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RetroChessBench, a 12-task retrograde chess benchmark demonstrating that even frontier language models like GPT 6 Astra largely fail at reconstructing and proving chess histories, exposing faulty deductions such as rejecting legal histories and treating temporary obstructions as permanent.
